stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin sign peace declaration
stories.summary: Three leaders pledge nuclear risk talks, but agree no arms cuts.

stories.headline: UN court: Myanmar committed genocide
stories.summary: The Hague rules 9-6 that Myanmar's forces committed genocide against the Rohingya, a first such finding against a state.

stories.headline: Houthi missile damages Riyadh tower
stories.summary: Windows blow out across seven floors of the PIF Tower as more missiles are intercepted.

stories.headline: Russia hits Kyiv in overnight attack
stories.summary: Overnight missiles hit Kyiv's infrastructure, as Ukraine reportedly strikes a chemical plant in Russia.

stories.headline: AI sell-off sinks Asian markets
stories.summary: Nikkei falls 4.8% and Kospi 5.3% after Anthropic's debut fails to calm fears over AI spending.

stories.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil fuel pledge
stories.summary: Talks spill into overtime as the Antalya draft deletes every mention of phasing out fossil fuels.
